center.locator: mean of the six reactor-building centroids, the plant boundary and the two derived hall positions
center.note: Map centre only: mean of the drawn features' centroids; not a claim about any structure.

levels.name: RENO near detector hall (~110 m.w.e. under a ridge)
levels.note: RENO TDR (arXiv:1003.1391) §1.2.2: "The near detector will be located at underground of a 70 m (AMSL) ridge with an overburden of ∼110 mwe". Rock depth in metres is not published, so depth_m is left null.

levels.name: RENO far detector hall (~450 m.w.e. under a 260 m mountain)
levels.note: RENO TDR (arXiv:1003.1391) §1.2.2: "the far detector is to be located under a 260 m mountain with the overburden of ∼450 mwe". Rock depth in metres is not published, so depth_m is left null.

name: Hanbit (Yonggwang) — reactor units and the RENO detector halls
notes: The near hall's distance checks to units 3–6 sit 3–4 % from the TDR figures (10–28 m), consistent with using reactor-building centroids as proxies for core centres over 300–740 m baselines; the tolerance on those checks is widened to 5 % with that reason and accuracy_m raised accordingly — see the geometry record.

summary.plain: The six Hanbit reactor units and the RENO near and far detector halls, positioned from the experiment's published core-to-detector distances.
summary.technical: Reactor-unit footprints and plant boundary from OpenStreetMap; near/far hall positions derived by multilateration from the six units using Table 1.2 of the RENO TDR (arXiv:1003.1391); the assignment of reactor numbers to buildings is the only one of the 720 permutations that fits.
